translation:
Fall 2026 Paan Scholarship and Culture Foundation Master's and Doctoral Scholarship Recommendations

The Paan Scholarship and Culture Foundation is selecting master's and doctoral scholarship recipients for Fall 2026 as described below. Students who wish to be recommended should first complete the scholarship recommendation form (Excel) and send it by email by Thursday, 10 September 2026, 17:00. (The email address is given in the original notice.) We apologise for the short notice, which is due to the department's schedule.

A. Number of recommendations: up to 1 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.

B. Eligibility: currently enrolled graduate students (master's, doctoral, or integrated master's-doctoral program) who have (or are expected to have) excellent research achievements.
- For detailed recommendation requirements, see the foundation's official letter requesting recommendations [Attachment 1].
- Selected scholarship recipients must upload their achievements under their future success plan to the scholarship foundation website by the first half of 2027.
- Those who have received this scholarship and the Daeha Scholarship Foundation scholarship two or more times are excluded from recommendation.

C. Scholarship amount: living expenses of up to 2,000,000 KRW. ※ The amount may vary according to the review committee's decision.

D. Required documents (1 copy each): recommendation letter (official seal omitted, submitted as a Hangul file), application form (handwritten, photo must be attached), self-introduction and future success plan (no more than 5 A4 pages, 10pt), certificate of enrollment, transcript (new students: transcript from previous school), resident registration abstract (including parents and siblings; students living alone must additionally submit a family relation certificate), documents proving achievements, copy of own bankbook, and consent forms for the collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university).

E. Selection procedure for new College of Engineering candidates
1) Deadline for submitting the department recommendation form [Attachment 2]: Thursday, 10 September 2026
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be regarded as having no candidate.
※ If applications exceed the final number of recommendations (2), applicants who meet the basic eligibility will be evaluated by the combined score of income bracket and grades; in case of a tie, candidates will be selected in order of income decile, then previous-semester grade point average, then credits completed in the previous semester.
2) Notification of the College of Engineering's final recommended candidates to departments: Friday, 11 September 2026, 16:00
3) Submission of final documents (originals and official letter): Wednesday, 16 September 2026
※ The official letter must be submitted and the original documents sent.

Attachments: 1. Foundation official letter and forms, 1 copy each. 2. Scholarship recommendation form, 1 copy. End.

Attached files (6): 2026-2 Paan scholarship application personal information collection and use consent form (PDF); 2026-2 Paan scholarship application form (HWP); [Foundation] 2026-2 Paan Scholarship and Culture Foundation master's and doctoral scholarship recommendation request (PDF); Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information (Scholarship and Welfare Division, external foundations) (HWP); Scholarship recommendation form (XLSX); Dean's recommendation letter (form) (HWP). The contents of these attachments were not read for this translation.
